# Wazuh Setup Notes

## Standalone Test Setup

**VM: `wazuh-manager` (standalone test)**
- Ubuntu ISO 64-bit, 6GB RAM, 4 CPUs, 40GB disk

**Install command:**
```bash
sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade -y
curl -sO https://packages.wazuh.com/4.14/wazuh-install.sh && sudo bash ./wazuh-install.sh -a
```
- Dashboard accessed at: `https://192.168.141.128`
- Admin password generated by install script — saved locally, not committed to repo

**Test Agent VM: `wazuh-agent-test`**
- Ubuntu ISO 64-bit, 3GB RAM, 2 CPU, 20GB disk
- IP: `192.168.141.129`

**Agent install command (generated by dashboard's "Deploy new agent" wizard):**
```bash
wget https://packages.wazuh.com/4.x/apt/pool/main/w/wazuh-agent/wazuh-agent_4.14.7-1_amd64.deb && sudo WAZUH_MANAGER='192.168.141.128' WAZUH_AGENT_NAME='wazuh-agent-test' dpkg -i ./wazuh-agent_4.14.7-1_amd64.deb
```

**Enable and start the agent:**
```bash
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable wazuh-agent
sudo systemctl start wazuh-agent
```

**Result:** Agent confirmed "Active" in dashboard under Endpoints within ~1 minute of starting.
